====Usage notes====
* The form {{m|en||arse}} (as opposed to {{m|en|ass}}) and its derivatives are usually used by speakers and writers in preference to {{m|en|ass}} in Britain, Ireland and the Commonwealth countries, though only regionally in Canada (in the [[Atlantic provinces]]). Historically {{m|en||arse}} was also used in [[New England]] but the form has now been superseded by {{m|en|ass}} throughout the US and in the rest of Canada.
